name: CASPER Data API
description: Static, public data interface for CASPER. Raw CSN remains the canonical source; parsed and filtered responses are exposed through the API client.
notes: CASPER is hosted as a static site, so arbitrary HTTP query execution is intentionally handled by the API client rather than a server runtime.
All derived data is generated from CSN and should be treated as a view of the archive, not a replacement for the source CSN.
